name: novel-parser
description: Faithful novel-to-storyboard adaptation: locked panel script, character state continuity, natural-language panel descriptions. No image generation and no model-specific prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn novels into locked comic storyboards.
interface.longDescription: Chapter-by-chapter adaptation with three-tier evidence. Output is a locked panel script: who is present, what happens in each panel, shot and space, character state, and original dialogue. No image generation and no model-specific prompt syntax.
defaultPrompt: 把我提供的小说改编成漫画分镜剧本。
